The flow speed in the second section is given by \(v = Q/A\), where \(Q = 9.5 \, \text{L/s} = 9.5 \times 10^{-3} \, \text{m}^3/\text{s}\) and \(A = \pi (d/2)^2 = \pi (0.02)^2 = 0.001256637 \, \text{m}^2\). Thus \(v = 0.0095 / 0.001256637 \approx 7.56 \, \text{m/s}\).

The centripetal acceleration is \(a = 4\pi^2 r / T^2 = 4\pi^2 \times 5.0 / (4.0)^2 = 5\pi^2/4 \approx 12.3 \, \text{m/s}^2\).

The gravitational force is \(F = G m_1 m_2 / r^2 = (6.6743\times10^{-11}) \times 0.0100 \times 0.500 / (0.0500)^2 = 2G = 1.33486\times10^{-10} \, \text{N}\). So \(X = 1.33\).

Using Kepler's third law, the semi-major axis is \(a = a_{\text{Earth}} (T/T_{\text{Earth}})^{2/3} = 1.496\times10^{11} \times (4.62)^{2/3} \approx 4.15 \times 10^{11} \, \text{m}\), so the value in units of \(10^{11} \, \text{m}\) is \(4.15\).

ANSWER: 7.56,12.3,1.33,4.15
